eventMetadata.context_description:
**Persistent cloud cover, light rain, and a cool northwest airflow kept Munich's peak temperature capped at 17°C on August 25, 2026.** Official forecasts and station reports (including Munich airport data) consistently showed morning readings around 12–14°C rising only modestly under overcast skies, with daytime highs limited to 16–19°C and many sources pinpointing the maximum near 17°C amid steady westerly winds and high humidity. This aligns with the market's overwhelming 99.9% implied probability for 17°C, reflecting real-time aggregation of observations rather than long-range models.

The outcome stands well below late-August climatological averages (~23°C), driven by a transient cool, moist air mass rather than typical summer warmth. Resolution hinges on the highest verified reading from authoritative stations; while microclimate variations or late-day clearing could theoretically shift the exact value by 1°C, current data show negligible chance of exceeding the 17°C threshold.
